security.title: Sign-in & security
security.description: You sign in with your password and a code sent to your email. This dashboard never sees either.
security.changePasswordNote: Opens the staff sign-in's “Set a new password” page and brings you back here. It may ask you to sign in again first.
security.methodsDescription: How you sign in, and your saved sign-in methods.
security.devicesDescription: See where you are signed in, and sign out other devices.

notices.success: Your password has been changed. Use the new one next time you sign in.
notices.cancelled: Password not changed. Your current password still works.
notices.error: Keycloak could not change your password. Try again.

contributions.title: Your contributions
contributions.description: What you have added to the catalogue, and where it stands.
contributions.createdHint: Attractions, stays and food listings you started
contributions.returned: {count, plural, one {One submission} other {# submissions}} came back with changes to make.
contributions.emptyDescription: When you send a destination for approval, it appears here with the decision it gets.

capabilities.title: What you can do
capabilities.description: Decided by your role. The screens offer exactly these.
capabilities.needOne: Need one of these? An administrator can change your role.
capabilities.technicalHint: The grants on your sign-in, as support and the API name them.

create.label: Create destinations
create.detail: Start new places as drafts. They stay off the public site until approved.

editAny.label: Edit any destination
editAny.detail: Correct and update every destination in the catalogue.

editOwn.label: Edit your own destinations
editOwn.detail: Keep the destinations you created up to date.

publishBoth.label: Publish and unpublish
publishBoth.detail: Change what travellers can see on the public site.

unpublish.label: Take destinations offline
unpublish.detail: Change what travellers can see on the public site.

publish.label: Publish destinations
publish.detail: Change what travellers can see on the public site.

approveStaff.label: Approve editor and BDO content
approveStaff.detail: Decide on what the reviewing desks write themselves.

verify.label: Verify destinations
verify.detail: Verify any destination on evidence — an invoice or a licence — and renew or revoke it.

listingsAny.label: Manage stays and food listings
listingsAny.detail: List, correct and publish the stays and food near every destination.

listingsPartner.label: Manage your business's stays and food
listingsPartner.detail: Keep the stays and food listings your partner runs up to date.

listingsOwn.label: Write your own stays and food listings
listingsOwn.detail: List stays and places to eat, and send them to an editor to publish.

taxonomy.label: Manage regions and taxonomy
taxonomy.detail: Tourism regions, provinces, interests, categories and tags, amenities, and the history vocabulary: periods, monarchs, styles and religions.

reviews.label: Moderate reviews
reviews.detail: Hide or restore what travellers write.

media.label: Upload media
media.detail: Add photos to destinations, stays and food listings.

people.label: Manage people and roles
people.detail: Create back-office accounts and assign roles.

audit.label: Read the audit log
audit.detail: See who changed what, and when.
